newsitem.title: USA: Horton files for 5 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Horton files for 5 mln common shares.

text.p: D.R. Horton Inc said Wednesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to five million in common shares.
Of the total, four million common are being sold by the company and one million by certain selling stockholders, the filing said. After the offering, outstanding will total 36,455,729 common shares.

Of the one million common to be sold by the shareholders, Donald Horton, chairman of the board and president of the company, will offer up to 795,000 common. This amount includes an aggregate 478,579 owned by Horton's children.

The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option to buy up to 750,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Merrill Lynch & Co and Salomon Brothers Inc.
Net proceeds will be used to temporarily repay indebtedness under revolving credit facilities and for general corporate purposes, the filing said.
Horton is a national homebuilder constructing and selling single-family homes in the metropolitian areas of the Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, Southeast, Southwest and western regions of the United States.
